messages:
maria: Noticed something odd during a canary: the infra deploy SA could list GPU nodes. Ran `kubectl --as=system:serviceaccount:infra:deploy-service get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia -o name` and it returned nodes. That SA should be namespace-scoped only.
ben: Which SA exactly and which cluster/namespace? can you paste the exact subject? quick checks first.
maria: serviceaccount infra:deploy-service, cluster was staging-2. I grabbed the apiserver audit event too: `system:serviceaccount:infra:deploy-service` performed `get` on `nodes` at 2026-03-20T17:12:08Z.
carla: I pulled RBAC and found a ClusterRoleBinding `infra-global-read` binding `ClusterRole=view-extended` to both group `infra-developers` and the SA `infra:deploy-service`.
carla: `view-extended` is an aggregated role (AggregationRule) and one of the aggregated rules gives `nodes: get,list,watch`. So the namespaced SA inherited cluster node read via that binding.
dave: Audit detail: TokenReview happened at 2026-03-20T17:11:43Z; token name `infra-deploy-token-9xx`. Source IP 10.2.3.4. deploy-bot also logged a canary completion event shortly after.
deploy-bot: Automated: canary deploy complete, token used: infra-deploy-token-9xx, job-id ci/4567
zoe: Security recommendations: 1) remove SA from ClusterRoleBinding ASAP or swap to a RoleBinding in the infra namespace 2) rotate the affected token(s) and mark them compromised until rotated 3) postmortem + short-term audit rule to surface SA subjects in CRBs.
ben: We should be careful removing the binding blindly if human infra devs depend on it. Proposed safe change: a) create a namespaced Role `infra:deploy-limited` with minimal verbs (pods, configmaps, secrets:get if needed) b) RoleBinding point SA to that Role c) remove serviceaccount subject from CRB but leave group binding d) run can-i tests before and after.
maria: Can someone paste the CRB YAML so I can craft the replacement quickly?
carla: CRB YAML:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: infra-global-read
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: view-extended
subjects:
- kind: Group
  name: infra-developers
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: deploy-service
  namespace: infra
```
ben: Implementation plan (low-risk): 1) create Role `infra-deploy-limited` in namespace infra with explicit verbs only 2) apply RoleBinding infra:deploy-service->infra-deploy-limited 3) patch CRB to remove SA subject (`kubectl patch clusterrolebinding infra-global-read --type=json -p '[{"op":"remove","path":"/subjects/1"}]'`) 4) `kubectl auth can-i list nodes --as=system:serviceaccount:infra:deploy-service` must be `no` 5) monitor audit logs for 24h.
zoe: Also: add an admission/OPA Gatekeeper constraint to deny ClusterRoleBindings that include `ServiceAccount` subjects unless on an allowlist. And add an automated sigsec review for AggregationRules that add cluster-scoped verbs to curated roles.
dave: I'll run the patch in staging and run smoke tests. I'll also block the CI token in the short term (CI will fail until we rotate tokens but that's acceptable).
maria: I'll coordinate with infra-devs so they aren't surprised by a drop in perms. Also will grep for scripts that do `--as=system:serviceaccount:infra:deploy-service` so we don't break automation.
carla: I'll write a migration playbook and include helm dry-run commands and who to call for rollback. Will include a snippet to detect similar bindings:
```
kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.subjects!=null) | select(.subjects[]?.kind=="ServiceAccount") | .metadata.name'
```
ben: Post-mitigation: 1) rotate all deploy tokens and record KMS envelope events tied to rotation 2) patch CI so robot tokens are short-lived TokenRequests instead of long-lived secrets 3) create an internal alert: CRB contains SA -> paging to sec-oncall.
zoe: Add to postmortem: why `view-extended` aggregated nodes (was historical, missed in review), why SA was added to CRB (convenience during onboarding), and corrective actions (admission controls, CI token policy, RBAC hardening checklist).
maria: Thanks all. Keep this thread for rollout steps and paste the migration playbook link when ready. :thumbsup:
